Bug_Explanation: The rule states that only one logger is allowed per class. This bug is demonstrating the violation of this rule by creating two loggers in the same class.
Trigger_Explanation: This JUnit test case generates an exception due to the violation of the rule that only one logger is allowed per class. The test case calls the showBug() method, which in turn tries to create two loggers for the same class, which triggers the bug and thus causes the test case to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results do not demonstrate the bug being triggered. The test run was successful, indicating that the code did not encounter any errors or exceptions. This suggests that the bug described in the bug information was not triggered.
